name: Baker House / W7
axes: Blender east,north,up; glTF east,up,south; identity runtime transform

source.positionBasis: horizontal bounding-box midpoint of original OBJ vertices

scope: Exterior only; no modeled accessible interior

sources.use: six floors, serpentine river frontage, suspended stairs, dining pavilion
north stair tile cladding and window grouping
south shape, window proportions, roofing, dining skylights
North stair stepped glazing and entrance canopy/door details

assumptions: Window bay widths, frames, pergola dimensions and rooflight counts approximated from photographs.
Measured source supports overall outline and elevation; south curved elbows are smoothed within the source footprint tolerance.
North stair bottom slopes are photo-informed reconstruction; invisible original measured collision envelope intentionally blocks exterior entry.
qualityStatus: Stage iteration; offline model inspected, in-game visual acceptance still required
changes: Planar three-dimensional aluminium frame extrusions, asymmetric sash lights and solid sloped projecting sills.
Separate semitransparent glass, recessed shading backing and varied roller blinds; no accessible interior is claimed.
225 x 75 mm water-struck brick coursing with warped mortar edges, normal relief and an independent roughness map.
North stair lower window sequence follows rising flights; source main envelope and base elevation retained.
Moon Garden light scoops have bell profiles, stems, flashing bases and full-detail guards.
Roof weathering and lap seams; unsupported repetitive rooftop room windows replaced with limited service vents.

lodPolicy.full: Complete outer frame extrusions, highlight lips, gasket strips, sill end caps and rooflight guards.
lodPolicy.mobile: Preserves silhouette, recess, glazing, blind depth, frame inner return and sloped sill; omits narrow highlight lips, gaskets, sill ends and rooflight guards.

exportOptimization: Only unit normals are quantized to aligned normalized signed bytes using KHR_mesh_quantization; positions, UVs and collision geometry are preserved.
knownGaps: Individual room window positions and some north-brick opening groups remain photograph-informed approximations, not an exact facade survey.
Terracotta tile joints and limestone surface aging are not yet individually resolved.
Glass uses PBR alpha blending with a shallow shading backing; the runtime environment must supply reflections and lighting, and full physical transmission is not modeled.
North entrance appendage retains the survey volume; detailed as-built lobby footprint remains uncertain.
Landscaping, sidewalk, terrain and scene lighting are outside this building-only source and require the integrated scene review.

offlineEvidence.kind: Actual Blender model renders with a neutral preview ground, excluded from both GLBs.
